text.t:
The ithos®️ wooden lamp, with its delicate sloth shape, combines timeless design, cosy light, and the charm of small details. Its warm white LED lighting creates a soft and comforting atmosphere, ideal for accompanying moments of reading, tranquillity, and snugness before sleep.

During the day, it serves as a decorative piece that adds personality and tenderness to a child's bedroom. With careful finishes and hand-painted details, it integrates harmoniously into environments inspired by nature, soft woods, and neutral tones.
Created to make rest times even sweeter and more special.

options.power.help.t: Batteries are included. The cable version comes with a remote control: on, off, dimming, auto-off, and a slow pulsing light effect.

options.engraving.help.t: A name, a date or a short phrase, engraved on the wood. Leave blank if you prefer no engraving.
